name: Adventure Mansion
detailed_description:
You came for the thrill of the chase—for an ancient relic hidden in a place the locals never dared tread, known only to some as Adventure Mansion.
But the mansion never let you leave.

You don’t know how long you’ve been here.
Long enough to forget why.
Until now.

Sparks of life stir in the halls—new explorers, living and unaware. And with them, a chance. Perhaps a way to finish what you started. But you’re not the only one who remembers.
You’re not the only one with unfinished business.

The mansion is waking up, and the thrill of the chase has taken on new meaning.

The relics are few. The exits, fewer still.
Not all will reach the end.
But the adventure demands to be completed.

**Warning:** This game contains flashing lights and intense visual effects that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Please play with caution.

short_description: A haunting multiplayer adventure where the dead return to finish what they started. Compete for relics and more, outmaneuver rivals, and escape before the mansion seals shut. Not all will reach the end. The adventure demands to be completed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
